Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [우선 처치] Gravebound Advance is a shield that absorbs magic damage, so break the Restless Amani shield with Holy damage from Execution Sentence and Divine Storm.
[생존기] When soaking Hungering Pyre in the intermission, reduce the damage with Divine Protection.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Rebuke.

Entombed Sentinels: [우선 처치] When a Venom Coagulation ooze spawns, dump Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence to kill it right away.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence until after the intermission.
[생존기] When soaking Unstable Miasma, reduce the damage with Divine Protection.

Vashnik the Malignant: [우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Divine Storm and Wake of Ashes before they reach the center.
[제어] Burning Venom can be held with Hammer of Justice until Hardened Venom.
@m [생존기] Line up Divine Protection with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Rebuke.
[우선 처치] Use Divine Storm on the two stacked bosses so the damage also hits First Mate Nama.
[위치] If you are the Blink Nova target, get away from the raid quickly with Divine Steed.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, reduce the damage with Divine Protection.
@m [위치] If To the Slaughter hits you and you get Virulence, spread out immediately with Divine Steed.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Kill the Venomous Emergence adds first with Divine Storm and Wake of Ashes.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, reduce the damage with Divine Protection.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Caustic Globule's Barbed Bulwark with Rebuke.

The Coiled Altar: [우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so dump Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence.
[차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Rebuke.
[회피] After soaking Guillotine, immediately get 40 yards away from the axe with Divine Steed.

Ula'tek: [해제] Blightscale Viper's Acidic Burst is a Poison, so clear it with Cleanse Toxins.
[우선 처치] Dump Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with Rebuke.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Divine Storm before they reach the bubble.
[생존기] Line up Divine Protection with the raid damage from Pop! and Unending Tides.
@m [우선 처치] Waterfog Shield reduces damage to nearby murlocs by 99%, so kill the Bubblefin Frostscale before using Divine Storm.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with Rebuke.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Voidmaw packs with Divine Storm and Wake of Ashes.
@m [우선 처치] In the intermission, pop Avenging Wrath and swap to the Abyssal Voidshaper immediately to kill it before it casts Gathering Darkness.

Vorasius: [우선 처치] Kill the Blistercreeps gathered at the wall together with Divine Storm so Blisterburst breaks the Void Crystal.
[회피] During Void Breath, run with Divine Steed to the far end of the room opposite the glowing hand.
@m [생존기] When the first Blistercreep pack pops, reduce damage taken with Divine Protection.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Rebuke or Hammer of Justice.
[참고] The boss takes 25% more damage during the 20 sec Entropic Unraveling, so line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence with it.
[위치] If you are the Despotic Command target, immediately separate from others with Divine Steed and move to the room edge just before it ends.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [차단] Interrupt Voidorb's Voidbolt with Rebuke or hold it with Hammer of Justice.
[생존기] Midnight Flames Shadow damage lasts 25 sec, so reduce damage taken with Divine Protection inside Radiant Barrier.
[분담] If the Gloomtouched damage on a Gloom soaker is heavy, take 30% of their damage with Blessing of Sacrifice.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [차단] After breaking War Chaplain Senn's Sacred Shield, interrupt Blinding Light with Rebuke.
[우선 처치] Commander Venel Lightblood takes 20% more damage right after the pull, so stack your AoE with Wake of Ashes.
[분담] When soaking Execution Sentence next to the target, reduce damage taken with Divine Protection.

Crown of the Cosmos: [우선 처치] Kill the Void Droplets under the sentinel by hitting them together with the sentinel using Divine Storm.
[회피] When Vorelus's Ravenous Abyss comes, get 15 yards out with Divine Steed.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with Rebuke or hold it with Hammer of Justice.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Rebuke.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Avenging Wrath to break the adds' Alnshroud shields quickly.
[회피] Get out of the Phase 2 Corrupted Devastation path with Divine Steed while killing adds.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] If your feather color matches, interrupt the embers' Light Eruption or Void Eruption with Rebuke.
[생존기] During the Phase 2 egg's Rebirth, dump Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence to burn down Immortal Flame.
@m [분담] If you are on orb duty, move while immune to all damage with Divine Shield to clear the Radiant Echoes orbs.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Interrupt the Safeguard Matrix's Safeguard casts with Rebuke and Hammer of Justice to remove all stacks.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with Rebuke.
[우선 처치] Kill the Midnight Crystals by hitting them together with Divine Storm before the cast finishes.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Always interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with Rebuke.
@hm [해제] Clear a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts with Cleanse Toxins.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Shroomlings and Bursting Shrooms gathered at the set spot with Divine Storm and Wake of Ashes.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.
